calibration.binding.observation_times.note: Predeclared elapsed simulation times for original-schedule drying-window synthetic liquid-water observations; not experimental sampling times.

calibration.difference_step.note: Finite-difference perturbation / synthetic recovery acceptance; numerical setting, not material evidence.

calibration.scale.liquid_water.note: Fixed residual normalization scale for the synthetic liquid-water demonstration; not a measurement standard deviation or material uncertainty.

calibration.scale.surface_temperature.note: Predeclared residual normalization for the local synthetic liquid-water and model-surface-temperature sensitivity comparison; not thermometer accuracy, measurement standard deviation or noise.

verification_scope.runs: Exactly three original 12-cell/60s drying_ramp+drying integrations: nominal, binding-energy-only plus1%, h-only plus1%; all other physics/process/numerics fixed.
verification_scope.derivative: Forward secant at declared finite 1% increment, physical units. Not a converged infinitesimal derivative.
verification_scope.normalization: J_ij=(dy_i/dp_j)*declared_range_width_j/row_scale_i. Surface2K and water1e-4kg/kg are residual scales, not noise.
verification_scope.diagnostics: Each single channel and combined rows: numerical SVD, matrix-rank tolerance, condition number and uncentered column cosine; raw inputs/matrices retained for independent arithmetic, no statistical or global claim.
verification_scope.verification: Physical budget for all three windows; only intended parameter changes; direct independent scalar D/J, analytic two-column Gram eigenvalues for singular values, numerical rank with reported machine tolerance; old entrypoints and forward bytes remain unchanged.
verification_scope.limits: No optimizer, repeated perturbation-scale search, extra mesh/time integrations, old UQ requalification, or material validation. Nominal drying failure retained. Fields only in memory.
verification_scope.step_coordinate: Reuse the existing relative fraction but perturb physical parameters, not the optimizer normalized coordinates. h20->20.2 here; normalized-x relative1% would20->20.1. D is transformed to declared-range coordinates afterward.

diagnostic.scope: Drying window only; no completed firing cycle or cooled-product result.
diagnostic.scope_note: Assumed local diagnostic at original nominal drying configuration, using calibration.binding.observation_times and calibration.difference_step. One baseline and one positive relative perturbation per registered parameter. Rows normalized by calibration.scale.<kind>, parameter coordinates by their declared range widths. No fitting, noise model, global identifiability or step/grid convergence claim. The existing difference_step supplies only the relative fraction: perturb physical p by 1%, not optimizer normalized x by 1%. For nominal h=20 and lower bound10, this diagnostic uses20.2, whereas optimizer x-relative1% corresponds20.1.
diagnostic.difference_scheme: One-sided physical-parameter relative step: delta_p=calibration.difference_step*p_nominal; transformed to the same range-normalized coordinates as fit, not the same optimizer-coordinate perturbation points.

free_water_ledger.inventory_definition: Free water is liquid water plus pore-gas H2O; it is not total water-equivalent hydrogen including minerals or organics.
free_water_ledger.units: mol of H2O; signed changes over the reported interval
free_water_ledger.sign_convention: Reaction sources are positive into each inventory. Evaporation extent is positive liquid-to-vapor and negative for condensation. Boundary in/out are separately nonnegative; net outward is out minus in. Cell redistribution is positive for net liquid gain from internal faces; the liquid exterior is closed.
free_water_ledger.accounting_basis: Reaction extent differences and gas boundary in/out differences use existing solver-integrated ledgers. Cell liquid redistribution is inferred as liquid inventory change minus stoichiometric liquid reaction sources; it includes numerical inventory/extent mismatch and is not an independent flux-integral check.
free_water_ledger.reaction_source_note: Non-phase reaction water is taken from each existing reaction stoichiometry and signed extent; retention-site loss creates no separate water source. Internal liquid and gas transfers cancel in whole-domain water accounting.

thermodynamics.elastic_storage: F_el=K(D/V,C)*V0*epsilon^2/2; K=K0*((D/V)/(D0/V0))^m*exp(-g*C); C=N*v_matrix*(x-x_ref)/V0; epsilon=V/V0-1-beta(T)-B(n,x)-eta+e0; K0*(e0-m*e0^2/2)=prestress; S_el=K*V0*beta'(T)*epsilon at fixed x,n; U_el=F_el+T*S_el. F_V=K*epsilon+V0*K_V*epsilon^2/2; mu_el_i=V0*K_D*epsilon^2*v_dry_i/2-V0*K*epsilon*B_ni-V0*g*K*epsilon^2*C_ni/2; -F_eta/V0=K*epsilon drives sintering. Direct D partials hold C and B fixed; Bdot and Cdot retain carrier birth and phase relaxation in U/S and equilibrium; Kdot=K_V*Vdot+K_D*Ddot-g*K*Cdot.
thermodynamics.liquid_relaxation_entropy_domain: Nonnegative per-active-mole kinetic dissipation, with carrier inventory subject to the existing declared inventory error budget. Raw extensive entropy is retained, including signed values from near-zero carrier roundoff; no clipping or new tolerance.

definitions.D: D[i,j]=(y_plus_j[i]-y_nominal[i])/delta_parameter[j]; units are observation unit divided by parameter unit. Rows follow observations and columns follow parameters.
definitions.J: J[i,j]=D[i,j]*declared_parameter_range_width[j]/observation_scale[i]; dimensionless, using the same parameter coordinate as fit. Scales are residual normalization, not measurement uncertainty.
definitions.machine_rank: NumPy matrix_rank default: count singular values greater than max(singular_values)*max(J.shape)*machine_epsilon. The actual tolerance is reported for each matrix.
definitions.condition_number: Largest divided by smallest singular value (2-norm); null means an exactly zero smallest singular value, hence infinite condition number.
definitions.uncentered_two_column_cosine: dot(J[:,0],J[:,1])/(norm(J[:,0])*norm(J[:,1])); columns are not mean-centered. Null means a zero column norm and undefined cosine.

diagnostic.limitations: Local one-sided finite differences at the declared nominal state and discretization, without optimization. Machine rank is not a pass criterion for real material, global identifiability, noise robustness or numerical derivative convergence. Condition numbers and column cosines depend on declared coordinate and observation scaling; stacking channels does not by itself establish statistical information gain. No parameter statuses or nominal model values are updated.

fixed_design_interpretation.note: At these fixed residual scales and six times, stacking surface temperature barely changes the smallest singular value and slightly increases the 2-norm condition number. All reported ranks are machine ranks only. This is not a statistical information or noise comparison.

next_bounded_gap: 仅将本轮物理参数相对扰动从1%减半至0.5%，对结合能和换热系数各新增一次原干燥窗口；执行前在根参数登记减半设置并固定同一名义基线、时刻与尺度，复用已保存基线，独立比较两档有量纲/归一导数和矩阵结构。仅此一次步长复核，不搜索更多步长、容差、网格或拟合；两档结果不作为严格导数收敛或实材辨识证明，不稳定则保留并限定结论。

independent_review.scope: Read-only physical-versus-normalized step distinction, fixed design, final source, independent matrix arithmetic, failed drying endpoints and non-statistical scope claims. No extra integrations.
